instruction: I want to set up a global hotkey for play/pause in VLC so I can control playback even when VLC is not the active window. How can I configure a global keyboard shortcut for play/pause?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
